current_round.prompt:
From: Kevin Xiong <kevin.xiong@insurity.com>
Subject: Bug: evidence[0]: invalid type: map output-contract fault survives the 4.3.2 unknown-field fix

Body:
Version: 4.3.2 (commit 48804eebdcd830cb98fe8dabea39ced4c651a36a)
Node: bo2lnxipsapp01 �P Agent model: claude-opus-4-7[1m] (also reproduced earlier on 4-8)
Severity: High �X silently discards a completed agent turn. In our case the implement agent ran ~1 hour (23 e2e runs, real auth fixes, isolated the target bug) and all of it was lost at the reporting step over the JSON shape.

Symptom

Failed round, failure_category: workflow:
Skill output contract failed: Skill invocation
1a7d38c65afa176c2734d64e26c9d9b8fe0fcbb869746ae3226a2fe93310a392
required bindings [default-implement] cannot authorize a gate: Error;
agent returned invalid structured Skill completion report:
does not match the required schema at field `evidence[0]`: invalid type: map, expected a string
Goal: 00000T12G5WS2J4A7NGFJ8C00F, round 4.

Root cause

src/application/agent_io/contracts/skill_result.rs:
- SkillReport (line ~35) is #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] with pub evidence: Vec<String> (line 40).
- The a4e27372 normalization in decode_result sanitizes only the top-level key set:
object.retain(|key, _| matches!(key.as_str(),
    "invocation_id"|"binding_id"|"role"|"outcome"|"summary"|"evidence"|"artifacts"));
  This strips unknown top-level fields (e.g. checklist) �X which fixes the unknown field variant. But it does not touch the contents of retained fields.

When the model emits evidence as an array of objects (e.g. [{"id":"P1","detail":"..."}] instead of ["..."]), retain keeps the evidence key, then SkillReport deserialization fails on Vec<String> �� evidence[0]: invalid type: map, expected a string. The normalization never had a chance to catch it.

So a4e27372 fixed the unknown-field variant but not the wrong-element-type variant of the same class of fault.

Reproduction

Feed decode_result a completion whose evidence is an array of maps:
{"outcome":"success","summary":"...","evidence":[{"id":"P1","note":"did X"}],"artifacts":{}}
�� errors with evidence[0]: invalid type: map, expected a string. (The existing test at ~line 191 shows the intended shape: evidence as strings, structured data like checklist under artifacts �X models routinely don't follow this.)

Suggested fixes (any one)

1. Coerce/normalize evidence elements in the same decode_result boundary: for each non-string element, stringify it (serde_json::to_string) or lift objects into artifacts �X mirroring how unknown top-level keys are already tolerated there.
2. Loosen the field type: evidence: Vec<Value> (or a #[serde(deserialize_with=...)] that accepts string-or-object and renders to string), keeping the strict persisted SkillResult as-is downstream.
3. At minimum, route this through the structured-output repair loop instead of hard-failing, so a malformed envelope gets one corrective re-prompt rather than discarding a completed turn.

Impact note

Because this rejects at the reporting step after the work is done, a long, successful agent turn is thrown away �X very costly. Same class as the earlier 2 distinct JSON candidates / unknown field checklist faults; the model just picks a different wrong shape.

[cid:insurity-small2_60d9d841-975e-4326-81a1-42eb773307d1.jpg]

Kevin Xiong

Senior Developer

T 860-616-7842
